# Hakscan

> Security scanning for AI-built apps. Connect a GitHub repo or live site, prove you own it, and get real security tools (Semgrep, Gitleaks, a passive OWASP ZAP baseline) run against it — with results triaged and explained in plain language by AI, not raw scanner output.

Hakscan exists for "vibecoders" — founders who ship apps built with AI coding tools and don't have a security background. Ownership verification (GitHub OAuth admin access, or a DNS/meta-tag challenge for sites) is enforced server-side before any scan runs; nothing here scans a target the user doesn't control. Live-site scans are passive/baseline only — no active exploitation.

## Product

- Free plan: 1 target, manual scans only.
- Pro plan: $24/month, unlimited targets, scheduled re-scans, priority queue, full PDF reports and email alerts.
- Sign up: /signup
- Log in: /login

## Policies

- Terms of Service: /legal/terms

## For AI agents and crawlers

This file exists because Hakscan's own audience is AI-assisted builders — it's a natural fit for agent-readable discovery, not just a formality. There is no API for third-party automated scanning; scans are triggered by an authenticated user through the dashboard after ownership verification, and that gate is intentional and non-negotiable.
